files.alt: Northlight shows a real magnetic heading, a large degree dial, sensor accuracy and Lantern, Night light and SOS controls.
Free spoken compass controls with offline voice ready, Speak direction and a real captured phone-heading result.
GPS altitude shows 94 m, mean-sea-level reference, reported uncertainty of plus or minus 84 m and a low-accuracy warning.
Actual red screen-light mode with brightness control and the Close Red light button.
Northlight Pro benefits explain saved bearings, spoken phone-turn guidance, extra light colours and adjustable strobe.
